content:
dataset:
  name: abide
  batch_size: 16
  test_batch_size: 16
  val_batch_size: 16
  train_set: 0.7
  val_set: 0.1
  path: [本机路径已省略]
  stratified: true
  drop_last: false
  num_class: 2
model:
  name: BrainHGT
  dim_hidden: 256
  num_heads: 8
  num_layers: 1
  dropout: 0.1
  dim_feedforward: 1024
  encoder_hidden_dim: 32
  num_communities: 8
  dice_path: [本机路径已省略]
  orthogonal: true
  freeze_center: true
  project: BrainHGT
optimizer:
  name: Adam
  lr: 0.0001
  match_rule: None
  except_rule: None
  no_weight_decay: false
  weight_decay: 0.0001
  lr_scheduler:
    mode: cos
    base_lr: 0.0001
    target_lr: 1.0e-05
    decay_factor: 0.1
    milestones:
    - 0.3
    - 0.6
    - 0.9
    poly_power: 2.0
    lr_decay: 0.98
    warm_up_from: 0.0
    warm_up_steps: 0
training:
  name: Train
  epochs: 1
datasz:
  percentage: 1.0
preprocess:
  name: non_mixup
  continus: false
repeat_time: 1
log_path: [本机路径已省略]
best_model_path: [本机路径已省略]
save_model: false
wandb_entity: BrainGraphTransformer
